format.observed: Single full-bleed opaque landscape poster; no comparison panels, mockup, logo, QR or watermark observed.

substantive_visual.location: Window-grid light above and left, diagonal pavement seams below/right, successive red prints
substantive_visual.observation: Large spatial light/pavement boundaries and worn soles express attentive walking and organize the whole frame.

assigned_style.observation: Precise flat graphic language is stronger after removal of stone granules. Yellow light and blue pavement intersect, red prints retain worn interruptions. Subtle broad gradients remain; neutral reading area has become yellow.

hangul.location: One title line and four body lines
hangul.observation: Body now has larger coherent Hangul bodies with clear counters, uniform baseline, consistent regular stroke and meaningful word spaces. Exact copy read without glyph ambiguity. A blue strip visually touches the top of the first title word.

information_relationship.location: Title to four-line body at upper left
information_relationship.observation: Shared left start, immediate proximity and continuous four-line paragraph connect the title to the entire explanation. Body reads comfortably at usage720; title remains main typographic anchor at thumbnail.

basic_style_exclusion.observation: Large projected-window intervals, cross-frame diagonal seams and cropped large shoe traces form the composition rather than a small illustration attached to a passive text board.

function_contact.reason: No functional physical contact or practical contact/event copy requested.

material_edge_finish.location: All large colored faces and pavement seam edges
material_edge_finish.observation: Sharper smooth flat surfaces replace stone texture, with faint shading still visible. Fine seam lines are clear; worn contact interruptions remain localized to red footprints.

located_observations.observation: Four planned meaning groups read as one connected paragraph.
The crossing window strip slightly reduces isolation of upper glyph edges.
Broad blue-yellow diagonal and two large red prints continue to establish the scene and directional rhythm.

residuals.location: Wide yellow area and lower/right blue pavement
residuals.observation: Stone granules are gone but subtle broad shading remains, so the finish is not fully uniform flat color.

residuals.location: Upper left, top portions of the first title word
residuals.observation: A narrow blue window-shadow strip crosses the upper part of the dark blue title and joins some glyph edges to the surrounding graphic. Wording remains readable; edge separation is reduced.

next_action: Final bounded repair to isolate title glyph edges from window strip and flatten residual broad shading; preserve readable four-line body and substantive scene.
